id: title:Gilbert09:keep a repartition that restarts from row 0

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion workflow checkpoint identity and rewrite tracking
review.reason: Adds checkpoint identity tracking and rewrite-aware checks to warehouse ingestion workflow, distinguishing checkpoint identity across restarts to prevent false stall detection and unnecessary rewrites.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of production benefit or incident avoidance. Tier 2 assigned based on bounded implementation and relevant checks, not broader systemic change.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assignment is made; this is an unassessed contribution.

observations.behavior: Adds checkpoint identity tracking: P1.F1.H1 adds _rewrite_checkpoint_id and _rewrite_advanced_past, P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 replace row-only progress checks with rewrite-aware checks, P1.F1.H4 records rewrite ID alongside row counts. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H4 add temp_uri and rewrite_id fields to pending and rewrite dicts. P1.F2.H2 and P1.F2.H5 expand parameterized tests to include temp/
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion workflow: distinguishes checkpoint identity across restarts, preventing false stall detection and unnecessary rewrites.
